4_taxonomy_question_log.notes: Parsed 15 unique papers into 249 question-level entries across a 12-topic interactive-multimedia taxonomy. Expected marks 1450; parsed 1436; 13/15 papers reconcile. Those caveats are recorded in taxonomy_summary.json and are the review items for this gate.

Topic mix is a smoothed 60-slot sequence from the modern papers; Part D topics are sampled from the six topics observed in modern structured questions.

LLM cost is $0 by design.
